cohort: All MB agency-service keys with twelve nonnegative integer published UPT entries and positive annual sum in 2019. Each year pair benchmark is restricted to that baseline cohort with all24 entries observed; every excluded key/reason retained.
mask_count: ceil(fraction*n), without tuning; ties by agency ID then type of service
missing_upper: gamma times the same service-unit calendar-month published UPT in 2019; lower0; untuned illustrative assumptions, not statistical confidence bounds
selection: No fitting, optimization, winner selection or stochastic masking. All27 masks,3 point views and3 bound assumptions retained. All source inputs/quality visible. Freeze executable dependencies before held analytical summaries.
source_gates: nonnegative integer ridership or explicit null
independent server monthly and agency-year count/non-null/sum controls
replay: Captured published snapshot, exact integer/rational arithmetic and independent SQLite reconstruction; no live historical-vintage availability claim
public_scope: Minimal federal aggregate public-domain service-count projection and original analysis; safety fields, private people/contact metadata and full third-party documents excluded
